summary: Janus Henderson Group plc filed an 8-K entering a side letter agreement amending its merger agreement with Jupiter Company Limited (Parent) and Jupiter Merger Sub Limited. The side letter sets the closing date for the merger (Merger Sub merging into Janus Henderson) at June 30, 2026, or seven business days after conditions are satisfied. No price per share, stake, or premium is provided; the filing focuses on timing and regulatory condition satisfaction. The board previously approved the merger. The transaction is a going-private acquisition by Parent. What to watch: the final closing date and any last-minute regulatory or shareholder issues affecting the risk-arb spread.
